digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. The dashboard has no new check-offs today, while email and calendar updates show that several decisions and delivery dependencies are still moving. The remaining work is concentrated around confirming owners, scope, and next-day decision points.

items.label: Confirm the Denver outcome and set the remaining rollout sequence
items.detail: No final Denver go/no-go result was found after today's testing and decision meeting. Confirm the functional test outcome, the Denver launch posture, and the rollout order for the remaining offices.

items.label: Close the Attorney Review scope and Service Cloud build dependencies
items.detail: Today's session set the short-term path around pre-conversion Service Cloud review, but the Phase 1-only scope is being rechecked and IT turnaround, attorney capacity, training, scripts, and the intake-review SLA remain open. Carry the confirmed scope and build asks into tomorrow's 9:30 AM follow-up.

items.detail: The project lead recommended pausing and re-evaluating the project pending Legal guidance and historical-data review. The project sponsor still needs to confirm the final direction by September 24.
